framework.summary: A developer that publishes and follows a safety and security protocol is shielded from liability for critical harms; publishing is a condition of that shield, not a flat duty.
framework.quote: published a safety and security protocol on its website that satisfies the requirements of Section

transparency_report.summary: A developer must publish a transparency report at release to get the liability shield; it is a condition of the shield, not a flat mandate.
transparency_report.quote: published a transparency report on its website at the time of the frontier model's release

incident_reporting.summary: The bill requires no incident reporting.

imminent_risk_reporting.summary: The bill sets no imminent-risk reporting window.

third_party_audit.summary: The protocol must say whether and how the developer uses third parties to assess risk; no independent audit is required.
third_party_audit.quote: whether and how a developer will use third parties to assess risk of critical harm

whistleblower.summary: The bill has no whistleblower protection.

registration.summary: A developer relying on a federal agency agreement must file a certification with the Attorney General; no pre-development registration is required.
registration.quote: shall file a certification with the Attorney General, in a manner prescribed by the Attorney General

shutdown.summary: The bill requires no shutdown capability.

compute_threshold.summary: A frontier model is one trained with more than 10^26 operations, or with a compute cost above $100,000,000.
compute_threshold.quote: is trained using greater than 10^26 computational operations

revenue_threshold.summary: A frontier model can also be defined by compute cost exceeding $100,000,000.
revenue_threshold.quote: has a compute cost that exceeds $100,000,000

harm_threshold.summary: Critical harm means death or serious injury of 100 or more people, or at least $1,000,000,000 in property damage.
harm_threshold.quote: the death or serious injury of 100 or more people or at least $1,000,000,000 of damages to rights in property

penalties.summary: The bill states no fine or enforcement remedy; it only removes liability for critical harms when conditions are met, and calls a false certification a violation without a stated penalty.

effective_date.summary: The bill text states no effective date.

notes: Liability safe-harbor bill, not a mandate. Penalties marked no is a judgment call: no fines are stated, but Sec. 10(c) calls a false certification a violation with no remedy given; owner may prefer not_in_bill. Text is one run-on paragraph.
